card.line: Zephath was a Canaanite city whose name means "watch-tower." Judah and Simeon destroyed it, and it was renamed Hormah.

moments.title: Judah and Simeon attack Zephath
moments.text: The men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath. They devoted the city to destruction, and it was called Hormah.
